children: Indian shares opened higher on Tuesday, led by information technology stocks and heavyweight HDFC Bank, although higher oil prices and global bond yields ahead of this week's Federal Reserve meeting kept gains in check.
rose 0.45% to 23,503.65, while the BSE Sensex added 0.53% to 75,178.2, as of 9:15 a.m. IST.
Eight of the 16 major sectors rose. The broader small-caps

soared 4.5% after calls for a slowdown in AI development. IT stocks have been a major laggard in market over the last year as new AI tools threatened the business models of traditional software services companies.
